# tplink_devices (Data Source)

Inventory of devices currently connected to the router (wired, host, guest, and IoT wireless segments).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tplink_devices" "inventory" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes Set) Connected devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) Device hostname as reported by the router.
- `ip` (String) Assigned IPv4 address.
- `mac` (String) MAC address (dash-uppercase).
- `type` (String) Connection segment: wired, wifi, guest or iot.
